title: Staff Portal Workbench customer commissioning

task.name: Commission a complete private staff portal, content migration and recurring analytics/editorial delivery
task.purpose: Give customer operators and accountable reviewers one complete history from approved source population and content decisions through actual native evidence, useful staff interfaces, full onward delivery and an independently reopened editable workspace.
task.request: Receive the existing Workshare and Installation packet, complete authorized private source manifest and actual selected customer workspace. Name source, content, tenant-operation, commercial, acceptance and receiving owners. Retain the entire approved source population, native contract and period, original files, hierarchy, owners, audience/permission mappings and editorial requirements. Prepare the unchanged original application privately; independently receive its complete selected source using the actual host Python. Review and start the original portal through managed Applications. Use the original portal, migration, analytics and editorial views. Preserve actual native tenant/run/principal/request identities and complete original response bodies; an existing completed operation is adopted without redispatch. Operate the same workspace through the25 registered customer-agent tools with exact original revisions/request IDs, private declared source inputs and full retained-file reads. Make accountable decisions against complete current evidence, export full original workspace and source delivery, independently receive and edit/reopen it, and record only observed outcomes in Installation.
task.completeOutput: One complete useful staff delivery edition: full approved source and native evidence, mappings/content/editorial state, accountable review decisions, all original request/history/object identities, readable reports and complete private source/workspace delivery; actual browser and customer-agent operation plus independently received editable history.
task.repeatTrigger: A distinct approved content population/change, source period, native reporting question or editorial release creates a linked task. Retry, pagination, alternative formats, repeated receiving and reopening of the same result remain the original task.
task.pricedUnit: One agreed complete customer staff delivery baseline or recurring accepted edition. Use existing Installation integer atomic price/count/budget and spending selections; preserve the existing Workshare's operator, hosting, source-maintenance and acceptance responsibilities.

source.reference: Use the authorized complete private source manifest, original Workshare/customer selections and exact full source/native/result/archive descriptors. Public adapter code carries no private case documents, commercial terms, source pins or tenant secrets.
source.mode: The unchanged private application owns its original SQLite state, sessions, native tenant client, editorial authorization and complete delivery reader. Public Merchant code adds installed lifecycle, host-declared agent transport and retention. No provider SDK/source or substitute native engine is introduced.
source.population: Retain the complete selected source, content, staff/audience/permission populations and all native pages/response objects. Preserve native bounds and full completeness indicators. An explicit selected subset is described as that subset; it is never reported as a complete tenant population.
source.meaning: Preserve original source identities, content hierarchy, field/value types, ownership/audiences, native principal/query/page/cooldown semantics, draft/review decisions and each actual returned identity. A browser load or HTTP200 is not acceptance of a full migration. Native failures, partial pages and unresolved differences stay visible.
source.changePolicy: Every mutation retains its actual workspace, actor, request ID and expected revision; original replay returns its saved result. Workspace selection clears the session's native account binding. A lost native capture acknowledgement is inspected using the same saved attempt, never automatically repeated. Private source and customer artifacts remain outside public distribution.

receiving.application: TJLabs Staff Portal Workbench public generic adapter at products/staff-portal-workbench. Commands staff-portal-workbench, -prepare, -managed and -receive; privately supplied exact source authority and original source path remain separate from the package.
receiving.acceptanceRule: Verify the complete private source and original delivery source population before opening a writer. Retain every selected native response and required content/analytics/editorial criterion, then record the accountable decision. Use actual desktop/narrow controls and complete downloads; view the actual screenshots and all outgoing attachments. Independently validate every workspace/source delivery member and cold reopen original history plus a deliberate local edit. Only actual observed receiving/native evidence satisfies acceptance.
receiving.changeAndWithdraw: Preserve previous request, source, mapping, query, draft and decision history. Use original revision guards and original account permissions. Applications Stop joins the original listener and HTTP workers; it does not assert a native operation completed. Commercial changes, withdrawn scope and returned work use the existing Installation process.
receiving.recovery: Read the complete host requests and original operation lookup. Mutation/upload replay preserves exact fingerprint and saved response. Workspace create/receive also preserve the original origin header when the session has moved to the result workspace. Native capture retains one dispatch marker and reads separate current-run evidence after uncertainty; another exchange needs a distinct explicit request. Full errors are observed outcomes, not assumptions of no effect.
receiving.maintenance: Deliver all new reusable adapter source publicly and the complete unchanged authorized original source privately. Keep manifests, source/archive bytes, native objects, original request/history, opening instructions and actual receiver results together. Name the original company sender and native operator in the private Workshare; preserve those owners and obtain the existing human authority for any customer tenant operation.

steps.title: Receive the complete customer and source selection
steps.result: Join the original Workshare/Installation terms, scope, period, owner assignments and privately supplied full source manifest. Preserve original operation and customer communication owners.

steps.title: Prepare and independently receive private complete source
steps.result: Verify all exact original files and delivery source closure. Preserve source provenance and actual host interpreter; retain private portable handover and independently received descriptors.

steps.title: Review and start the original staff application
steps.result: Use Applications Review/Save/Start with the exact private launch configuration, actor, source authority, workspace and allowed native origins. Open the four original views.

steps.title: Retain and map the full source population
steps.result: Upload complete declared sources, preserve source completeness references, review schema/content/hierarchy/owner/audience/permission mappings and keep original binary objects.

steps.title: Continue the original native operation
steps.result: Adopt existing completed evidence or perform only the explicitly authorized original tenant operation. Bind actual native principal/query/run/request/page/result identities and cooldowns; never manufacture completion.

steps.title: Review content, analytics and editorial results
steps.result: Use full original differences and reporting views. Retain every unresolved issue and accountable decision; preserve native editorial authorization and original draft/history.

steps.title: Operate exact requests through the customer agent
steps.result: Use25 actual registered tools against the same session/workspace. Retain exact action/upload requests, original observed responses, distinct uncertain capture evidence and full byte-readable outputs.

steps.title: Export complete original workspace and source delivery
steps.result: Download full workspace and complete private source delivery ZIPs with actual identities. Open readable reports and all selected originals; keep credentials outside exported artifacts.

steps.title: Receive and reopen independently
steps.result: HTTP receive validates a workspace ZIP and immediately selects its distinct received workspace. Complete source delivery uses the original delivery receiver/CLI. Preserve original history and later local edits on replay.

steps.title: Inspect the actual outgoing screens and attachments
steps.result: Use desktop/narrow controls, loading/empty/error/recovery states, downloads and reopened exports. Look at actual screenshots and open all relevant ZIP/report/PDF contents; repair concrete rendering defects.

steps.title: Record acceptance and the next useful edition
steps.result: Save actual source/native/decision/export/receiving identities in Installation. Distinct approved new scope/period/output may be another task; retries and transport copies are not additional purchases.

inputs: Complete existing Workshare/Installation packet with actual customer, scope, assignments, network/asset/recipient, integer atomic price/count/budget and spending authority.
Complete privately authorized application source, exact external source manifest/SHA, original delivery source inventory and original source provenance.
Approved complete content, staff/audience/permission and source period selections, full original files and completeness references.
Actual selected workspace/source/history and original tenant/native operation/request/result/archive identities; existing completed work is preserved.
Explicit allowed native origin and private host token input when authorized; tokens, access keys, cookies and CSRF stay outside agent results.
Full original content/analytics/editorial decisions, returned differences, readable reports, source/workspace ZIPs and independent receiving.
Actual viewed desktop/narrow screens, controls/downloads/reopened exports and original equipped receiver receipt.
